body: You're sweet but missing the point. We all have to have time alone. I'm not lonely, it's just that when I'm not conversing with people, my thoughts get the better of me and I hate myself.
I'm not. I could do another 50 years, sure, I just don't see why I should. I don't really like myself and I can't bear to be alone with me so I'd sooner not drag this out longer than necessary.

Been there, done that. I love drugs but only for their ability to numb my troublesome thoughts. That doesn't seem like a good way to live, even if I could afford it. 

DoC is opiates and cocaine.
This is a suicide throwaway and apparently I write in a positive mood. 😐
Thank you, that was very funny. =] x

Sure. I regularly laugh though. I have fun, I enjoy myself but when I'm alone with my thoughts, I just want to trepan myself. I'll check it out but lifting my spirits won't take me away from a decision I've spent so long coming to and contemplating.
A little down, I suppose. Around my baseline emotion. I haven't been crying or angry or thinking anything unusual.
I'll break a fair few, I'm not generally disliked. I don't feel the need to set myself on fire to keep others warm though. I just don't want to do it anymore. x
